items.markdown:
![The Only Homemade Cold Brew Coffee Recipe You Need - Broma Bakery](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10082016-2302-0066-0000-5883c9fa2a02:4)
To make a smooth batch of [cold brew coffee](https://www.google.com/search?q=cold+brew+coffee&kgmid=/g/122z2fx6&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjt9e21nquXAxXh_rsIHTj_ApcQ3egRegoIAggACAAICBAG) at home, `use a simple 1:8 ratio of coarse-ground coffee to filtered water to create a strong concentrate`.[[1]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/cold-brew-coffee)[[2]](https://counterculturecoffee.com/blogs/counter-culture-coffee/guide-to-cold-brew)[[3]](https://cookieandkate.com/cold-brew-coffee-recipe/)

### Ingredients & Equipment

- **Coffee:** 85 grams (about ¾ cup whole beans ground to a coarse, sea-salt consistency)
- **Water:** 700 ml (about 3 cups of filtered water, room temperature)
- **Vessel:** A 1-quart mason jar, pitcher, or French press
- **Filter:** A fine-mesh sieve lined with a paper coffee filter or cheesecloth[[1]](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/brew-guide-ozone-cold-brew)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4W5RQrSSVKg)[[3]](https://cookieandkate.com/cold-brew-coffee-recipe/)[[4]](https://www.barschool.net/recipes/cold-brew-coffee)[[5]](https://extractcoffee.co.uk/about-us/behind-roastery-doors/easy-recipes-for-iced-coffee-and-cold-brew-at-home/)


---

### Step-by-Step Instructions

1. **Combine:** Place the coarse coffee grounds into your mason jar or jug according to the [Cookie and Kate Recipe Guide](https://cookieandkate.com/cold-brew-coffee-recipe/).
2. **Add Water:** Pour in the room-temperature filtered water. Stir gently to ensure all the grounds are fully saturated with no dry pockets.
3. **Steep:** Cover the container with a lid and place it in the refrigerator (or leave it at room temperature) for **12 to 18 hours** (up to 24 hours for a deeper flavor).
4. **Strain:** Set your fine-mesh sieve over a pitcher or measuring cup, line it with a paper coffee filter or cheesecloth, and pour the coffee through to remove all fine sediments.
5. **Store & Serve:** Seal the finished concentrate in a jar and store it in the fridge for up to **7 days** . To serve, fill a glass with ice, combine **1 part concentrate with 1 to 2 parts water or milk** to taste.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QUify5FKUJY)[[2]](https://cookieandkate.com/cold-brew-coffee-recipe/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4W5RQrSSVKg)[[4]](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/brew-guide-ozone-cold-brew)[[5]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/cold-brew-coffee)
